description: Approve and render up to 20 variants. Call ONLY after the user approved the preview. Pricing: character portrait 1 credit; preview 1 credit only when a new start frame is generated; a variant with a new clip 42 credits; a re-caption (same setting + expression, different hook, reuses the clip) 1 credit. The whole batch is reserved in one step before anything is generated — all or nothing; a short balance returns 402 and charges nothing. variantIds approves drafts from autoshort_ugc_preview; variants adds new hooks (setting/expression default to the latest previewed variant's, so they become cheap re-captions of its clip; fromVariantId re-captions a rendered clip). A clip that cannot be made falls back to the still frame and its clip credits come back. Poll autoshort_ugc_get_campaign every 30 seconds.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry-safe: the same key returns the first batch and charges nothing.

fromVariantId.description: Re-caption this variant's clip with the new hook.

name: autoshort_ugc_render_batch
